date.weekday.doc: day of the week as a number, 1 = Sunday .. 7 = Saturday

device.is_24_hour.doc: whether the user has selected 24-hour time

device.distance_units.doc: the distance unit setting: 0 = metric, 1 = statute

device.elevation_units.doc: the elevation unit setting: 0 = metric, 1 = statute

device.temperature_units.doc: the temperature unit setting: 0 = metric, 1 = statute

device.pace_units.doc: the pace unit setting: 0 = metric, 1 = statute

activity.stress_score.doc: current stress score, from a rolling 30s average

activity.time_to_recovery.doc: time to recovery from the last activity

ambient.altitude.doc: altitude above mean sea level, from barometer or GPS

weather.feels_like_temperature.doc: wind chill or heat index -- how the temperature actually feels

user.vo2max_running.doc: running VO2 max, calculated from historical data

user.vo2max_cycling.doc: cycling VO2 max, calculated from historical data

user.resting_heart_rate.doc: average resting heart rate, calculated from historical data

complication.battery.doc: a non-negative Number percent 0 to 100 representing battery charge

complication.steps.doc: a non-negative Number of steps for the current day, not available in wheelchair mode

complication.calories.doc: a non-negative Number of calories burned for the current day

complication.floors_climbed.doc: a non-negative Number of floors climbed, not available in wheelchair mode

complication.intensity_minutes.doc: a non-negative Number of intensity minutes that resets weekly

complication.date.doc: a String with the day of the month and the month e.g., 28 Mar

complication.weekday_monthday.doc: a String with the day of the week and the day of the month e.g., Mon 28

complication.current_weather.doc: a Weather.CONDITION_* for the current weather

complication.forecast_weather_1day.doc: a Weather.CONDITION_* for the forecast weather one day in the future

complication.forecast_weather_2day.doc: a Weather.CONDITION_* for the forecast weather two days in the future

complication.forecast_weather_3day.doc: a Weather.CONDITION_* for the forecast weather three days in the future

complication.calendar_events.doc: a String with the time of your next calendar event

complication.sunrise.doc: a non-negative Number representing seconds since midnight local time of the sunrise

complication.sunset.doc: a non-negative Number representing seconds since midnight local time of the sunset

complication.altitude.doc: a Float of the current altitude in meters

complication.sea_level_pressure.doc: a Float in pascals of the current pressure

complication.heart_rate.doc: a non-negative Number in beats per minute

complication.weekly_run_distance.doc: a Float of your weekly run distance in meters

complication.weekly_bike_distance.doc: a Float of your weekly bike distance in meters

complication.recovery_time.doc: a Number of minutes remaining in your recovery time

complication.stress.doc: a Number representing your current stress level

complication.body_battery.doc: a Number representing your current body battery

complication.vo2max_run.doc: a Number representing your running VO2 max

complication.vo2max_bike.doc: a Number representing your cycling VO2 max

complication.training_status.doc: a String representing your training status

complication.race_predictor_5k.doc: a Number representing your predicted 5K time in seconds

complication.race_predictor_10k.doc: a Number representing your predicted 10k time in seconds

complication.race_predictor_half_maratho.doc: a Number representing your predicted half marathon time in seconds

complication.race_predictor_marathon.doc: a Number representing your predicted your marathon time in seconds

complication.race_pace_predictor_5k.doc: a Float representing your 5k pace in meters/second

complication.race_pace_predictor_10k.doc: a Float representing your 10k pace in meters/second

complication.race_pace_predictor_half_ma.doc: a Float representing your half marathon pace in meters/second

complication.race_pace_predictor_maratho.doc: a Float representing your marathon pace in meters/second

complication.pulse_ox.doc: a non-negative Number as a percent from 0 to 100 representing your blood oxygen

complication.respiration_rate.doc: a non-negative Number representing your breaths per minute

complication.solar_input.doc: a non-negative Number representing percent between 0 to 100 of solar charge

complication.current_temperature.doc: a Float representing temperature in degrees Celsius

complication.high_low_temperature.doc: a String providing the high and low temperature values in a format similar to "H <high> / L <low>"

complication.wheelchair_pushes.doc: a non-negative Number of pushes for the current day, only available in wheelchair mode

complication.last_golf_round_score.doc: a String in the format "<LastRoundTotalScore>(<Offset>)" where Offset is "E" for even-par, a negative value for under par, or a positive value for over par

complication.sleep_score.doc: a non-negative number from 0 to 100 representing sleep score
